title: Convex geometry of diffusion laws and gradient flows for stochastic control
summary: We study gradient-type dynamics for weak stochastic control through the laws of controlled diffusions on path space. Although the objective is generally nonconvex in the drift, a uniformly convex running cost induces a strictly convex functional of the corresponding path law and hence a natural Bregman geometry. We construct the associated implicit proximal scheme and prove its well-posedness and convergence to a continuous-time mirror flow. When the mirror cost coincides with the running cost and the law-dependent potential is linear, the flow becomes affine in centered entropy coordinates.…
